name_reason: Name is fully compliant and accurate. Prefix data_fd2_ (game global) + battle_ (summon-spell animation is a battle subsystem, consistent with sibling symbols data_fd2_battle_summon_* in anisummn.c) + summon_anim_variant_b_ (domain: identifies the variant-B 6-slot summon animation; '_b' is a variant label A/B/D/E in this file, NOT a Ghidra address residue) + color_rotation_counter (reflects the scalar role -- a counter -- and its purpose: driving per-slot color rotation). No hex address-residue suffix. Consistent with sibling counters data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_a_color_rotation_counter @ 0x5401A and data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_d_color_rotation_counter @ 0x540B7.
purpose: Color-rotation counter (single mod-10 byte) for the variant-B 6-slot summon animation; drives the per-slot color index during TICK frames.
logic_summary: uint8 zero-bss runtime scratch (on-disk 0x00), accessed only by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot (0x26BFD). On INIT (state_code 0) it is seeded to 6 -- MOV [0x54052],AL at 0x26CAC, where AL is the i<6 loop counter left at 6. During a frame-7 color rotation (TICK states 2/5/8, when terminate_flag==0) it is incremented and reduced mod 10: INC byte ptr [0x54052] at 0x26D53; MOVZX EDX,byte ptr [0x54052] at 0x26D59 feeding IDIV by 10; MOV byte ptr [0x54052],DL at 0x26D6C. The wrapped value is then copied into the active slot's color index (data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot_color_idx_array[i]). All access is byte-wide with a zero-extending read (MOVZX), confirming element type uint8. Seeded at INIT before any read each animation run, so it is plain zero-bss runtime state.
element_semantics: Single unsigned byte mod-10 counter (range 0..9 after wrap; seeded to 6 at INIT). Each frame-7 rotation increments it, reduces it mod 10, and writes the result both back to itself and into the rotating slot's color index, cycling through the 10 per-color row offsets in data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_b_10color_y_offset_table.
notes: Verified against ground truth via Ghidra. get_xrefs_to(0x54052): WRITE at 0x26CAC (INIT seed), READ_WRITE at 0x26D53 (INC), READ at 0x26D59 (MOVZX feeding IDIV 10), WRITE at 0x26D6C (mod-10 store) -- all inside fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot. read_memory(0x54052) = 0x00 (BSS, .object2). is_const=false: the game writes it at runtime (INIT seed + per-rotation increment/wrap), so it must remain mutable. uint8 confirmed by byte-wide MOVZX read. Src comment (anisummn.c lines 534-549) is already accurate and precise -- it states the mod-10 role, INIT seed of 6 with exact address, the three rotation-step addresses, MOVZX->uint8, and zero-bss nature; left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep). No PLATE_COMMENT exists at the data address (verified null via run_script_inline); the owning function's plate already documents this global accurately and consistently with the src comment, so ghidra_plate_action=none. No source edit made.
